The Chinese Communist Party has a simple strategy: divide and conquer.

When ethnic tensions, political conflicts, and social divisions erupt online, it's worth asking who benefits. After Singapore pushed back against Beijing's claims of cultural kinship, anti-Indian content suddenly surged across social media, prompting government intervention.

In this episode of China Uncensored, we look at how the CCP exploits existing divisions, amplifies social tensions, and uses information warfare to weaken countries from within.

Watch now to see one of China's most effective tools of influence.
